lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like array of high-luminance circular clusters is observed posterior to the gills, organized into roughly three primary horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank. Local maxima are concentrated in a cluster directly posterior to the fifth gill slit.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal spot rows to form a series of rectangular grid nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A continuous horizontal ridge feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side to a distinct shadow gradient on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The macro-mask of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered toward the lower half and the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, high-luminance blobs on the proximal leading edge of the pectoral fin.
